notes: Black Knight gameplay causality with direct public switch writes only (keyboard handling and the driver's simulator stay off). Three balls rest on ball ramp switches 17, 18 and 19; a coin and the credit button start a game, which throws a ball (solenoid 6) into the shooter lane (switch 45). The kicker and bumper scoring switches 21, 22 and 36 show PinMAME's switch-driven special solenoids 17, 18 and 19; the synthetic flipper buttons 82 and 84 show outputs 45-48. Each drop bank is completed with its three targets held down (as real drop targets stay down) and released after the reset, showing reset solenoids 2-5 and the Magna-Save lamps 9 and 10; the Magna-Save buttons 10 and 9 then energize magnet relays 10 and 9. The eject hole (24) kicks with 8, a ball on the bottom lockup switch (41) is held and a new ball thrown with 6, a ball in the outhole (20) is kicked with 1, and three playfield-tilt closures (46) pulse relay 11 twice and tilt the ball on the third (game-on 25 drops). Run from an NVRAM initialized by one prior empty-NVRAM power-up.
